rows.note: Use this for the ability or skills involved in organizing something, as in “organizational skills.”

example.english: My organizational skills are pretty good, so I can arrange events much faster.
example.traditional: 我嘅組織能力幾好，安排活動快好多。

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for matters relating to an organization, rather than a person's organizing skills.

example.english: This is an organizational arrangement; everyone just needs to follow it.
example.traditional: 呢份係組織方面嘅安排，大家跟住做就得喇。
